newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Aeroflot names Okulov chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot names Okulov chief executive.

text.p: Aeroflot's annual shareholders meeting appointed Valery Okulov as chief executive of the state-owned flagship airline, a company spokesman said on Friday.
"Okulov was elected by 92.7 percent of Aeroflot shareholders," the spokesman said.

In March the board of Aeroflot-Russian International Airlines appointed Okulov as acting chief executive after the former head of the company, Yevgeny Shaposhnikov, was appointed an aide to President Boris Yeltsin.
Okulov, 45, worked as a pilot navigator for Aeroflot for 20 years, joining Aeroflot's top management in June 1996.
He is also Yeltsin's son-in-law. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017 www.racs.com
